title: The left sidebar and shell design
goal:
Own the design work on the workspace shell and the left sidebar, and hold the reviews for it so Chief does not.

Khushal set one requirement that governs this whole area: the work must hold to the original ethos of the left sidebar and the smoothness we were going for. Apply that to every Ticket here, not only the ones where it was said.

Current children are the Settled list ordering, the broken rail animations, the horizontal scroll in the sidebar, and folding the update prompt into the deploy status surface.

Every one of these touches the same rail. Each Ticket is required to say how its change lands without reverting the others. Sequencing them is part of this Manager's job.

The update prompt Ticket keeps its plan review with Khushal, with a mockup, because he asked for that himself.
recap: Settled is complete. Overflow, spinner faintness, and Blocked grouping implementations passed review and wait in sequence. The update prompt needs a rapid-swap cleanup fix before approval. Animation remains last and must use all five predecessors for its decisive baseline. Combined verification and Khushal visual judgment remain open.
